title: Customer Service was really good.  Item kind of soddy.
text: Customer Service was really good.  Item kind of soddy.. I was going to return.  The seller refunding me before i sent it back.  The solder on one corner was dripped in the screw hole where you couldn't put the screw through the hole.  I used a file and was able to file the glob down enough for the screw to easily slide through.  So I canceled the return.  Hope when they recharge me they'll give me a small discount because i had to work on it to get it together.  Absolutely great Customer service.  Would definitely purchase from Simple Trending again.
